title: Instruction Memo 10-33 To DDOS And All Senior Detectives

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4758
Date 12 / 4 / 33

Instruction.
Memo. No. 10/33.

Headquarters, Crime Branch,
April 11, 1933.

D.D.O.s. &
All Senior Detectives.

Rape & Indecent Assault &
Sodomy Cases.

It is always advisable in any of the above cases to have
fresh stains on bedding and clothing examined as soon as possible
by a Doctor. By microscopic examination he can immediately
discover the presence of live spermatozoa. This is good evidence
that an act of emission has recently taken place and will support
other evidence o' the criminal act it is desired to prove.

〔此处为手写签名〕
D. C. (Crime).
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 4758
日期 1933年4月12日

指令。
备忘录第 10/33 号。

总部，刑事科，
1933年4月11日。

副督察及
所有高级探员。

强奸、猥亵侵犯及
鸡奸案件。

在处理上述任何案件时，均宜尽快请医生对床单和衣物上的新鲜污渍进行检查。通过显微镜检查，医生可以立即发现活精子的存在。这是近期发生过射精行为的良好证据，并将支持旨在证明的犯罪行为的其他证据。

〔此处为手写签名〕
D. C.（刑事科）。
